Subject: Your land dispute matter - O.S. No. 2212/2019

Dear Mr. Patel,

Thank you for meeting us on 18 December 2019 about your dispute with Vandana Mittal. As we understand it, construction has started on the disputed plot. The matter is listed before the Mumbai District Court.

Our advice is to seek a temporary injunction to stop construction on the plot. Please collect photographs of the construction and the land records and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
